name: Aegon

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

signatureAbility:
Relentless Assault
At the end of the fight, Aegon adds [1 - 75]% of his final Combo Meter into his Persistent Combo, up to 999 hits total. Aegon's abilities that count the Combo Meter add his Persistent Combo on top of it.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Base Critical Rating is 0. Critical Rating is increased by +[34.26] for each hit of the Combo Meter.
Any Critical Rating Aegon would receive from a source other than his Combo Meter is converted directly into Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: Passive - Combo Meter Abilities
content: Aegon unlocks additional Passive Abilities as his Combo Meter increases.
5 Hits: Critical Hits have a 40% chance to Purify one Debuff.
10 Hits: Critical Damage Rating is increased by +[13.58] for each hit of the Combo Meter.
20 Hits: When the Opponent Evades, Aegon activates a Combo Shield for 5 second(s) and has a 45% chance to become Unstoppable for 2 second(s).
30 Hits: Aegon can strike with Critical Hits even while the Opponent is Blocking.
50 Hits: Charging a Heavy Attack grants Aegon 1 second(s) of Unstoppable. Cannot be activated while his Heavy Attack ability is on cooldown.
75 Hits: Opponents have -85% Block Proficiency when Aegon strikes with a Critical Hit
100 Hits: Critical Hits have a 100% chance to Purify one Debuff.
150 Hits: Critical Hits grant a True Accuracy Buff for 0.75 seconds. This stacks up to 3 times.
200 Hits: Critical Hits ignore 100% of the Opponent's Physical Resistance.
300 Hits: Critical Hits grant a Fury Buff, increasing Attack by +[923.8] for 1 second(s). This stacks up to 3 times.
500 Hits: Critical Hits cause Opponents to suffer -100% reduced Defensive Ability Accuracy for Aegon's next hit
750 Hits: Critical Hits grant 1.5 seconds of Unstoppable and Combo Shield. This stacks up to 3 times.
1000 Hits: Critical Hits cause Aegon's next Hit to be Unblockable

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Aegon activates Combo Shield, and cannot lose more than 5% of his maximum Health from a single Hit, other than Special Attacks, for 6 seconds.
Once this ability expires, it goes into cooldown and cannot be reactivated for 15 second(s).
Landing a Heavy Attack reduces the cooldown of this ability by 3 second(s).

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: 100% chance to gain a Fury Buff for 6 seconds, granting +[2,309.5] Attack.
Gain 1 additional Fury Buff for every 50 hits on the Combo Meter, then refresh those Buffs. Aegon can have up to 6 Fury Buffs total.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict Bleed over 6 seconds, dealing [461.9] direct damage for each hit of the Combo Meter, up to 60 hits.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to Stun the Opponent for 1 second(s). The duration of the Stun increases by 0.1 second(s) for each hit of the Combo Meter, up to 7 second(s) total.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Relentless Assault
content: At the end of the fight, Aegon adds [1 - 75]% of his final Combo Meter into his Persistent Combo, up to 999 hits total. Aegon's abilities that count the Combo Meter add his Persistent Combo on top of it.
